india.label: Cyclone watch · 16 Nov
india.headline: IMD puts Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha on cyclone watch
india.summary: The IMD’s 5:30 a.m. IST bulletin tracked a deep depression over the Bay of Bengal. It forecast a severe cyclone by 17 November and a very severe cyclone near Andhra Pradesh around the night of 19 November.
india.context: Fishing and coastal operations could be disrupted. Follow the IMD’s track updates and warnings for your district and waters.

india.label: Trade · 15 Nov
india.headline: Goyal says India and the US agreed on preferential access
india.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said Sunday that the US had agreed in principle to give Indian goods lower duties than competing suppliers. Talks on the first phase of the trade deal continue.
india.context: The advantage for exporters will depend on products covered, final tariff schedules and when those rates take effect.

india.label: Prices · 16 Nov
india.headline: India’s wholesale-price release puts input costs in focus
india.summary: October wholesale inflation is due on Monday. September’s reading rose to 11.39%, with fuel and power prices up 25.85% year on year.
india.context: Watch whether cost pressures broaden beyond fuel. Higher input costs can squeeze manufacturers’ margins and feed through to retail prices.

india.label: Diplomacy · 16 Nov
india.headline: Modi heads to Manila for the ASEAN and East Asia summits
india.summary: The prime minister departed for Manila on Monday for the 17 November summits, highlighting trade, transport links and maritime security in India’s ties with ASEAN.
india.context: Watch the summit statements for trade and transport commitments that could affect how Indian firms reach Southeast Asian markets.

india.label: Aviation safety · 16 Nov
india.headline: US FAA starts five-day audit of India’s aviation oversight
india.summary: The FAA scheduled a 16–20 November assessment of India’s safety oversight, including airworthiness, flight operations and licensing. India currently holds the US regulator’s Category 1 rating.
india.context: Watch the findings and the rating decision. The assessment can affect Indian airlines’ ability to expand US routes and codeshares.

world.label: Middle East · 15 Nov
world.headline: Yemeni forces pull back from a key Red Sea shipping route
world.summary: Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces announced a redeployment from the Bab el-Mandeb area to defend Aden. Bahrain separately said it intercepted Iranian aerial attacks.
world.context: Bab el-Mandeb links the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. Watch for shipping advisories and diversions that could raise freight costs on India–Europe routes.

world.label: China economy · 16 Nov
world.headline: China’s factory output and retail sales growth slow
world.summary: October factory output grew 4.8% year on year, down from 5.5% in September. Retail sales growth eased from 1.1% to 0.4%, and the decline in fixed-asset investment widened.
world.context: Slower production and demand can affect commodity exporters and companies that sell into China. Watch for stimulus and whether November spending picks up.

world.label: Humanitarian aid · 15 Nov
world.headline: Four governments urge Israel to let Gaza winter aid in
world.summary: Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK asked Israel to allow immediate aid access after flooding in Gaza. Their joint statement said 150,000 tents and other supplies were held at the border.
world.context: Watch whether crossings open and aid agencies can deliver shelter to families before winter conditions worsen.

world.label: Japan GDP · 16 Nov
world.headline: Japan’s economy unexpectedly shrinks as spending weakens
world.summary: Japan’s July–September GDP fell at an annualised 0.1% pace, compared with a 0.3% growth forecast in a Reuters poll. Household consumption fell 0.3% from the previous quarter.
world.context: Watch real wages and spending for signs of recovery. They will help shape the Bank of Japan’s next rate decision.

world.label: Black Sea · 15 Nov
world.headline: Drones hit three ships near Romania’s Sulina canal
world.summary: Romania’s prime minister said Sunday that drones struck three commercial vessels in the Black Sea. The defence minister said crews controlled the fires and reported zero casualties.
world.context: Repeated attacks near the Danube outlet could affect route planning and insurance costs. Watch for maritime advisories and NATO’s response.

markets.label: Indices · 16 Nov, 10:00 a.m. IST
markets.headline: Nifty and Sensex climb as foreign buying supports the open
markets.summary: Nifty 50 rose 0.76% to 25,334.80 and Sensex gained 0.87% to 82,303.36 at 10 a.m. IST. After the weekend break, banks gained 1%, IT 0.8%, and 12 of 16 major sectors advanced.
markets.context: Reuters linked the gains to softer crude and $8.9 billion in net foreign buying so far this month. Watch whether gains spread to smaller companies.

markets.label: Rupee and debt · 16 Nov morning
markets.headline: Inflation and US yields put the rupee and bonds in focus
markets.summary: On Friday the rupee closed at ₹94.24 per US dollar, and the 10-year government bond yield ended at 7.3079%, up 12 basis points for the week. Reuters cited higher oil and US yields as pressures.
markets.context: Watch India’s wholesale-price release and Wednesday’s Fed minutes for shifts in rate expectations that could affect borrowing costs and the rupee.

markets.label: Commodities · 16 Nov, 9:23 a.m. IST
markets.headline: Brent eases near $95.50 and Indian gold is ₹1,37,610
markets.summary: In its morning update, Financial Express quoted Brent down 0.33% at $95.52 a barrel and indicative Indian 24-carat gold at ₹1,37,610 per 10 grams.
markets.context: Oil flows from the Gulf and the rupee both matter for India’s fuel import bill. Compare local gold quotes at the same purity and time.

markets.label: Company catalyst · 16 Nov, 9:22 a.m. IST
markets.headline: Tata Motors PV falls as JLR cuts its outlook
markets.summary: Reuters put Tata Motors PV down 7.5% at ₹265.90 in its 9:22 a.m. IST report. JLR cut its FY27 adjusted EBIT margin guidance from 4% to 2–3%.
markets.context: JLR now expects about £1.25 billion of free cash outflow this fiscal year. Watch cash generation and retail demand alongside margin recovery.

markets.label: IPO calendar · 16 Nov, 10:54 a.m. IST
markets.headline: Three IPOs are scheduled to open, led by Mahanadi Coalfields
markets.summary: Crystal Crop Protection opens 18–20 November at ₹259–272. Mahanadi Coalfields opens 19–23 November at ₹129–136, and SME issuer Watrana Rentals opens on 19 November. Upstox showed no listings this week.
markets.context: Mahanadi’s offer is a sale by Coal India, worth up to ₹8,981 crore at the top of the band. Check exchange notices for changes.

tech.label: AI hardware · 16 Nov
tech.headline: Asian chip shares fall ahead of Nvidia’s earnings
tech.summary: Asian semiconductor shares fell Monday after Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO last week. Nvidia’s results are due on 17 November US time, early on 18 November in India.
tech.context: Watch data-centre sales and guidance for clues about chip demand after the leadership transition.

tech.label: AI business · 16 Nov
tech.headline: Anthropic’s IPO will test appetite for AI model companies
tech.summary: Reuters reported that Anthropic is expected to start trading later this week. Its preliminary prospectus proposes a Nasdaq listing and an offer of 825 million shares.
tech.context: Watch the final price and how much cash goes to Anthropic. The filing gives the founders’ vehicle 50.1% of voting power on most shareholder decisions.

tech.label: Cybersecurity · 15 Nov
tech.headline: La Poste confirms data leak affecting 22 million people
tech.summary: La Poste said a September attack on its Maileva mailing subsidiary exposed the names and postal addresses of 22 million recipients of documents sent by client organisations.
tech.context: The breach shows how much personal data can collect at a mailing vendor. Watch for notices from affected organisations and targeted impersonation attempts.

tech.label: Semiconductor supply · 16 Nov
tech.headline: SK Hynix plans five years of supplier support
tech.summary: SK Hynix said it plans to spend ₩1.4 trillion, about $1.05 billion, over five years to help South Korean suppliers of chip materials, parts and equipment.
tech.context: A proposed Yongin testing facility is due to open in May 2027. Watch whether smaller suppliers can qualify products for commercial production sooner.

tech.label: Satellite internet · 16 Nov IST
tech.headline: Vulcan launch failure destroys 40 Amazon Leo satellites
tech.summary: United Launch Alliance said its Vulcan rocket failed about ten minutes after liftoff in Florida on Sunday local time. Forty satellites for Amazon’s broadband network were lost.
tech.context: A launch interruption could slow the network rollout. Watch ULA’s investigation and whether Amazon can keep upcoming launches on schedule.

mind.label: Decision psychology · 2015
mind.headline: Fear and anger can pull risk judgments in different directions
mind.summary: A behavioural-science review describes experiments in which fear raised perceived risk and anger lowered it, including for events unrelated to the cause of the emotion.
mind.context: Before a consequential decision, name the emotion you are carrying and ask whether it comes from the decision itself. That can help you check your first impression.
mind.source: Lerner et al., Annual Review of Psychology

mind.label: Group behaviour · 2010
mind.headline: Turn-taking is one clue to how well groups work
mind.summary: In experiments with 699 people, group performance across tasks was associated with more equal conversational turn-taking and higher social sensitivity.
mind.context: In a meeting, try a short first round so quieter participants can contribute before discussion settles around the first idea. The experiment found associations.

mind.label: Work psychology · 2026
mind.headline: Unfinished tasks can follow you after hours
mind.summary: A meta-analysis found that unfinished work was associated with more work-related thoughts during off-hours. The associations were strongest for emotionally charged rumination.
mind.context: Try leaving a written next action before signing off. The analysis measured the association with unfinished tasks, and the note is a practical experiment to try.
mind.source: Wendsche et al., Anxiety, Stress & Coping

mind.label: Evolution · 2022
mind.headline: Guppies can evolve similar traits through many small genetic effects
mind.summary: Trinidadian guppies repeatedly evolved similar life-history traits across predation environments. Genetic mapping suggested many small effects for traits such as male age and size at maturity.
mind.context: Similar outcomes can emerge through a complex genetic basis. The visible trait gives only part of the evolutionary story.

mind.label: Evolution · 2018
mind.headline: Hurricanes can change which lizards survive
mind.summary: After two hurricanes, researchers revisiting island anoles found that survivors differed from the pre-storm populations in body size, limb proportions and toe-pad size.
mind.context: A single extreme event can impose strong selection. Following later generations would show whether the population shift persists.

marketing.label: India · MakeMyTrip · 14 Nov
marketing.headline: MakeMyTrip gives a travel sale a familiar ritual
marketing.summary: The India-focused Travel Ka Muhurat Sale launched with six films starring Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh, covering flights, stays and other categories. Members had early access and limited offers ran in evening windows.
marketing.context: A culturally familiar moment can coordinate attention. Separate creative by shopping need, and make the actual offer windows easy to find.

marketing.label: India · Google Android · 10 Nov
marketing.headline: A day without an itinerary becomes an Android demo
marketing.summary: Google India followed Kareena Kapoor Khan around Singapore in a film released on Instagram and YouTube, using tasks such as identifying Peranakan shophouses to show Gemini in use.
marketing.context: Build a demo around moments where a feature answers a question the audience can immediately understand.

marketing.label: India · CP PLUS · 5 Nov
marketing.headline: CP PLUS uses a familiar phrase to introduce smarter security
marketing.summary: CP PLUS featured Ranveer Singh in a new Indian brand film that revisits its familiar Hindi surveillance line while introducing AI-powered security features.
marketing.context: A recognisable line can carry existing brand recognition into a new product story. Show clearly what the added capability does.

marketing.label: Global · Deutsche Telekom · 2 Nov
marketing.headline: Deutsche Telekom produces one festive story for ten markets
marketing.summary: Take Time to Connect launched in Slovakia and was planned for ten European markets. It tells a grandfather–granddaughter story, with cuts ranging from six seconds to 140 seconds for different placements.
marketing.context: Decide which moment conveys the story on its own before planning shorter edits. Keep the idea recognisable across placements.

marketing.label: Global · Tesco UK · 1 Nov
marketing.headline: Tesco makes grocery delivery central to a Christmas film
marketing.summary: The Wrong Address reunites two former school friends after a misdirected grocery order. Tesco debuted a 60-second version on ITV and extended the campaign with social content and in-store experiences.
marketing.context: A service can do the dramatic work in a story. Here delivery creates the problem, gives the characters a reason to meet and carries the brand’s message.
